graphs.title: G7 real GDP
graphs.transformations: Saved graph exports real GDP levels in each source series' original units. These levels have different currency, scale and base-year conventions; compare normalized growth rather than raw levels across countries.

graphs.title: Auto jobs and manufacturing
graphs.transformations: Saved graph exports monthly seasonally adjusted levels, thousands of persons. Motor vehicles and parts is a subset of manufacturing; dealers are in retail trade.

graphs.title: CPI and PCE inflation
graphs.transformations: FRED PC1 transformation: percent change from year ago, calculated from each monthly seasonally adjusted index. CSV values are percentage points, e.g. 3.4 means 3.4 percent.

graphs.title: Selected state manufacturing
graphs.transformations: Saved graph exports monthly seasonally adjusted levels, thousands of persons. This is the supplied selection of states; it is not a complete Midwest aggregate. Pennsylvania is outside the Census Midwest region.
